metadata.description: Region for the API and its private network: the database's region (Central US), since a SQL virtual network rule admits only subnets in the server's own region.
Stable suffix for names that must be unique across all of Azure (storage, function app).

Public hostname for the API. Cloudflare proxies it (DNS: a proxied CNAME to the Function app, plus the asuid TXT record that proves ownership). TLS to Azure uses its own certificate; Cloudflare terminates the public one.
Browser origins allowed to call the API.
Daily ingestion cap in GB for the API's workspace (log-machina).
Daily ingestion cap in GB for the browser's workspace (log-machina-web). About 50 MB: hundreds of times today's real traffic.
Most Function instances that may run at once. One is plenty for today's traffic and caps how fast a flood could use up the free grant; raise it once Cloudflare rate-limits the API.

$fxv#1._comment: Cloudflare proxy address ranges (https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/). Refresh with scripts/refresh-cloudflare-ips.sh, then redeploy.

allowanceQuery.name: free-allowance-watch
allowanceQuery.displayName: Free allowance watch: GB ingested this month, by table (this workspace)
allowanceQuery.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > startofmonth(now()) and IsBillable
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000, 3) by DataType
| order by GB desc

apiQueries.name: api-requests-24h
apiQueries.displayName: API requests by endpoint, last 24 hours
apiQueries.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false), AvgMs = round(avg(DurationMs), 1), P95Ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1) by Name
| order by Requests desc

apiQueries.name: api-failures
apiQueries.displayName: API failures and exceptions, last 7 days
apiQueries.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Success == false
| join kind=leftouter (AppExceptions | project OperationId, ExceptionType, OuterMessage) on OperationId
| project TimeGenerated, Name, ResultCode, DurationMs, ExceptionType, OuterMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc

apiQueries.name: health-checks
apiQueries.displayName: Health endpoint: calls per hour and speed
apiQueries.query:
AppRequests
| where Name == "health"
| summarize Calls = count(), AvgMs = round(avg(DurationMs), 1), MaxMs = max(DurationMs) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

apiQueries.name: season-origin-hits
apiQueries.displayName: Season API: calls that reached Azure, per day
apiQueries.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and Name == "season"
| summarize OriginCalls = count(), Refused = countif(ResultCode startswith "4"), Failures = countif(Success == false), AvgMs = round(avg(DurationMs), 1) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day desc

apiQueries.name: saints-publish-runs
apiQueries.displayName: Saints publish runs: result, database wake time, size
apiQueries.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) and Name == "publishSaints"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationId, Success, TotalMs = round(DurationMs)
| join kind=leftouter (AppTraces
    | where Message startswith "published saints snapshot" or Message startswith "connect attempt"
    | summarize Detail = take_anyif(Message, Message startswith "published"), WakeRetries = countif(Message startswith "connect attempt") by OperationId) on OperationId
| extend ConnectMs = toint(extract(@"database connect (\d+) ms", 1, Detail)), Feasts = toint(extract(@"(\d+) feasts", 1, Detail)), Bytes = toint(extract(@"(\d+) bytes", 1, Detail))
| project TimeGenerated, Success, ConnectMs, WakeRetries, TotalMs, Feasts, Bytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc

apiQueries.name: saints-snapshot-fallbacks
apiQueries.displayName: Saints snapshot: times the API could not read it (empty is good)
apiQueries.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and Message startswith "saints snapshot unavailable"
| summarize Times = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Message
| order by Last desc

siteQueries.name: site-page-views
siteQueries.displayName: Site: page views by page, last 7 days
siteQueries.query:
AppPageViews
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Views = count() by Page = tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)
| order by Views desc

siteQueries.name: site-referrers
siteQueries.displayName: Site: how visitors arrive (referrer), last 30 days
siteQueries.query:
AppPageViews
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend Ref = tostring(Properties.refUri)
| extend Source = iff(isempty(Ref), "(direct or hidden)", tostring(parse_url(Ref).Host))
| where Source !in ("machinachristi.com", "www.machinachristi.com")
| summarize Views = count() by Source
| order by Views desc

siteQueries.name: site-countries
siteQueries.displayName: Site: page views by country, last 30 days
siteQueries.query:
AppPageViews
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Views = count() by ClientCountryOrRegion
| order by Views desc

siteQueries.name: site-time-on-page
siteQueries.displayName: Site: time on page (visible seconds), last 30 days
siteQueries.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and Name == "page-time"
| summarize Seconds = sum(todouble(Measurements.visibleSeconds)) by OperationId, Page = tostring(Properties.page)
| summarize Visits = count(), MedianSeconds = round(percentile(Seconds, 50), 1), P90Seconds = round(percentile(Seconds, 90), 1) by Page
| order by Visits desc

siteQueries.name: site-csp-reports
siteQueries.displayName: Site: Content Security Policy reports, last 30 days
siteQueries.query:
AppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and Name == "csp-violation"
| summarize Reports = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Page = tostring(Properties.page), Directive = tostring(Properties.directive), Blocked = tostring(Properties.blocked), Disposition = tostring(Properties.disposition)
| order by Reports desc

siteQueries.name: site-script-errors
siteQueries.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and ClientType == "Browser"
| summarize Count = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Page = OperationName, Message = OuterMessage
| order by Count desc
